releases.notes:
## World Remembers: Living Legends 1.1.0

This update expands Living Legends with a large built-in compatibility pass, improved generated place names, and several polish/fix passes for both Fabric and NeoForge.

### Highlights

- Added built-in content compatibility for many popular mods.
- Added cross-loader compat for:
  - The Aether
  - Deeper and Darker
  - Bosses of Mass Destruction
  - Terralith
  - Incendium
  - Dungeons and Taverns
  - When Dungeons Arise
  - Towns and Towers
  - Regions Unexplored
  - Explorify
  - Illager Invasion
- Added NeoForge-specific compat for:
  - L_Ender's Cataclysm
  - The Twilight Forest
- Added Fabric-specific compat for:
  - BetterEnd
  - BetterNether
  - AdventureZ
  - VoidZ
  - Mythic Metals
- Improved RU/EN generated names for vanilla and compatibility content.
- Fixed repeated fall-death places using the same name every time.
- Improved name audit/debug tooling for generated place variety.
- Refreshed public documentation for 1.1.0.

### Map compatibility

- JourneyMap: discovered fantasy labels, destinations, and Place Visual Themes.
- Xaero: manual destination-only waypoints.
- FTB Chunks: manual destination-only waypoints.

### Notes

- Map integrations are optional.
- Some compatibility entries are loader-specific.
- Existing named places do not automatically rename themselves after naming updates.
- Fabric and NeoForge jars are separate downloads.

### Downloads

Use the Fabric jar for Fabric 1.21.1.
Use the NeoForge jar for NeoForge 1.21.1.

# World Remembers: Living Legends 1.0.0 - NeoForge

This is the NeoForge build of the first full 1.0.0 release for Minecraft 1.21.1.

World Remembers: Living Legends turns important player moments and world events into named places. Death sites, battlefields, discoveries, boss sites, pet memorials, named mob memorials, and landmarks can become part of your world's history.

## Features

- Automatic named places created from important world events
- World Journal item with a book-style GUI
- Title overlay when entering remembered places
- `/places` commands for lookup, admin tools, import/export, and diagnostics
- Rename, delete, restore, and teleport actions with permission checks
- Lore-style chat notifications when new places are created
- Localized generated names
- Config validation and debug tools
- Data-driven compat registries for bosses, structures, biomes, mobs, blocks, and dimensions
- NeoForge storage, events, networking, client GUI, and title overlay support

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.x
- Java 21

## Installation

Use this file only with NeoForge.

For multiplayer, install the mod on both the server and the client for full functionality.  
For singleplayer, install it on the client.

Do not install the Fabric and NeoForge jars together.

## Notes

Back up important worlds before installing or updating.

## World Remembers: Living Legends 1.0.0-rc.1

First release candidate for Fabric 1.21.1.

### Highlights
- Named places generated from world events
- Six naming styles
- World Journal item and GUI
- Place title overlay
- Candidate decay
- General landmark spacing
- Import/export
- Config validation
- Data-driven compat registry foundation

### Known limitations
- Fabric 1.21.1 only for now
- NeoForge is not production-ready yet
- No map/waypoint integration yet
- Third-party compat packs are not bundled yet

Back up important worlds before testing.
